prompt: A library reading room with tall, dark-wood bookshelves lining the left wall. A librarian stands behind a checkout desk at the room’s entrance. The bookshelves are taller than the librarian. On the desk sits a stack of three books to be shelved. A reader sits at a reading table in the center. A desk lamp shines onto an open book on the table. Along the right wall is a row of chairs, and their number is twice the number of books on the checkout desk. A rolling ladder is positioned against the bookshelves, and a patron is standing on the ladder to reach a high shelf. A clock is mounted above the entrance. A globe on a pedestal is beside the checkout desk, and near the globe is a cup with some pens; the number of pens is two more than the number of books on the desk. The reader is closer to the desk lamp than to the shelves.
